diagnosticWindows.label: v1.1.2-260920
changelog: [improvement] Watch keeps an app's own logs by UID so pidof misses no longer leave the pane empty
[improvement] One Drop Watch also keeps send/receive notes and Bluetooth/Wi-Fi lines, not only advertise heartbeats
[bugfix] Opening Diagnostic no longer ANRs ColorOS while listing installed apps on the UI thread
